description:
Ideal ride for off-road cycling and going to school or work. This electric mountain bike is perfect for adventure lovers, trail bikers, working moms and dads, students, office workers, and city dwellers.

The electric bikes adopt superior 100% percent aluminum alloy frame, the front fork is made of high-steel packed with premium comfort shock absorption, and also double layer aluminum alloy 26-inch wheel

Matrix LCD display gives you all information you need: Odo, trip, speed, motor output, battery indicator, and of course advanced settings.

Front/Rear mechanical disc brake

Easy riding: throttle; pedal assistant pedaling ；

26'' Wheels, with 1.75'' air tire.

It's equipped with a high speed 350 Watts motor.

36V 10Ah Li-ion removeable battery. Easy to take out. Charging time 4-6 hours.

Shimano 6-speed-gears
